geometry.note: flux uses the Voronoi area its own faces bound; water volumes use the export's cell_area so the reduction identity against surface_water.py is exact

water_table.at_transmissivity_floor_note: a numerical bound, not a physical one: T = K0 f exp(-d/f) underflows on steep bedrock where f is a metre. These cells' depths are a lower bound rather than a value

basin_exchange.what_this_is: a measurement, not a change: Qg is reported per basin and is NOT wired into carve_verdict.py
basin_exchange.why: the surface arm is recomputed on the mesh rather than taken from the coupling matrix, so the only difference between the two arms is the groundwater term

carve_verdicts.criterion: carve_verdict.py's own: overflow when the aridity index is at or below basins.nc's critical_aridity_index
